title: 第1章 坟堆里爬出来的少年郎第2章 我为什么不会飞呢
lines: 神州大陆，天云山脉。
云海宗总坛，星罗峰。
山腰，弟子房舍。
夜。
一位俊朗的持剑青年，来到一间房舍外，左右看了一眼，见周围无人，这才敲响了房门。
“林师兄，是我，许开。”
“进来吧。”
许开推门而入。
屋内只点着一根烛火，显得有些昏暗。
房间不大，摆设很简单，一张桌，几张椅，一张床，一个浴桶，外加一个竹制屏风。
此刻，木床上盘膝坐着一位青年，剑眉星目，面如刀削，十分英俊。
此人名唤林易，云海宗宗主的六弟子，长的帅，修为高，不折不扣的天之骄子。
林易淡淡的问道：“许师弟，事情办妥了？”
许开轻声道：“嗯，已经将那小子埋到落霞峰后面的乱葬岗了。”
“没出什么岔子吧。”
“没有，那小子死的透透的，埋了后我还在他坟堆上踩了几脚。”
床上盘膝而坐的林易微微点头，道：“许师弟，此事你办的不错，不过咱们云海宗是名门正派，叶风又是玉龙师叔的弟子，他的死，我们不能沾染因果，否则你我都会万劫不复。”
许开连忙道：“林师兄放心，此事我会永远烂在肚子里，没人知道叶风死了，更没有人能找到他尸体，就算玉龙师叔回来，也不可能查出任何蛛丝马迹。”
林易俊朗的脸上，露出了满意的笑容。
从怀中拿出一物，丢给了许开。
许开接过，是一小袋黑晶灵石，赶紧拜谢，道：“多谢林师兄赏赐。”
林易摆手道：“这是你应得的，你暂且回去吧，过几天我们去一趟药圃，做善后工作。”
许开点头，拱手告辞。
在他离开后，林易表情变的有些阴鸷。
他自语道：“叶风，希望你早点投胎吧，我们也是奉命行事，要怪就怪你自已，谁让你的好奇心那么重呢。”
乱坟岗，深夜。
月光透过稀疏的云层，斑驳地洒在杂草丛生的地面上，映出一个个若隐若现的坟头，随处可见森森白骨与跳动的鬼火。
偶尔传来的几声乌鸦与野猫叫声，给这里又添了几分诡异。
毫无征兆，一只满是泥土的手掌，从地下猛然探出。
紧接着，浑身泥土的少年，艰难的从泥土里爬了出来。
少年四仰八叉的躺在地上，贪婪的呼吸着掺杂腐烂气味的空气。
好一会儿气息才喘允呼。
他坐起来，见周围都是坟茔，一脸懵逼。
“这他娘的是什么鬼地方，谁给我埋在土里的……啊！
死人！”
少年看到了身边一具人类尸体，以为是假人，随手扒拉了一下。
忽然，少年愣住了。
令人作呕的腐烂气味，尸体上蠕动的肥硕蛆虫，手上黏糊糊的腐肉粘液，绝对不可能是假的！
少年瞳孔急速收缩，尖叫一声，双腿乱蹬，连连后退。
content_en:
China Continent, Tianyun Mountains.
Yunhai Sect's main altar, Xingluo Peak.
On the mountainside, there are disciples' houses.
night.
A handsome young man with a sword came outside a house, looked around and saw no one was around, then he knocked on the door.
"Who?"
"Senior Brother Lin, it's me, Xu Kai."
"Come in."
Xu Kai pushed the door open and entered.
There was only one candle burning in the room, which made it look a little dim.
The room is not big, and the furnishings are very simple, including a table, a few chairs, a bed, a bathtub, and a bamboo screen.
At this moment, a young man sat cross-legged on the wooden bed. He had sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, and a face as sharp as a knife. He was very handsome.
This person's name is Lin Yi, the sixth disciple of the Yunhai Sect's leader. He is handsome, has a high level of cultivation, and is truly the pride of heaven.
Lin Yi asked calmly: "Junior Brother Xu, has the matter been settled?"
Xu Kai said softly: "Well, the boy has been buried in the mass grave behind Luoxia Peak."
"Nothing went wrong."
"No, that kid was dead. After he was buried, I stepped on his grave a few times."
Lin Yi, who was sitting cross-legged on the bed, nodded slightly and said: "Junior Brother Xu, you did a good job in this matter, but our Yunhai Sect is a well-known and upright sect, and Ye Feng is a disciple of Uncle Yulong. We cannot be tainted by the cause and effect of his death, otherwise you and I will be doomed."
Xu Kai said quickly: "Senior Brother Lin, don't worry, I will rot in my stomach about this matter forever. No one knows that Ye Feng is dead, and no one can find his body. Even if Senior Uncle Yulong comes back, it is impossible to find any clues."
Lin Yi's handsome face showed a satisfied smile.
He took something out of his arms and threw it to Xu Kai.
Xu Kai took it and found a small bag of black crystal spirit stones. He quickly thanked him and said, "Thank you, Senior Brother Lin, for the reward."
Lin Yi waved his hand and said: "You deserve this. You can go back for now. We will go to the medicine garden in a few days to do the aftermath."
Xu Kai nodded and said goodbye.
After he left, Lin Yi's expression became a little sinister.
He muttered to himself: "Ye Feng, I hope you will be reincarnated as soon as possible. We are also acting under orders. If you want to blame, it is you who makes you so curious."
…
Mass graves, late at night.
The moonlight shines through the sparse clouds and dapples the overgrown ground, reflecting the looming tombs. White bones and beating will-o'-wisps can be seen everywhere.
The occasional calls of crows and wild cats add a bit of eerieness to the place.
"Poof!"
Without any warning, a hand full of soil suddenly popped out from the ground.
Immediately afterwards, the boy covered in mud climbed out of the mud with difficulty.
The young man lay sprawled on the ground, greedily breathing in the air mixed with the smell of decay.
It took a while for him to catch his breath.
He sat up and saw tombs all around him, looking confused.
"What the hell is this place? Who buried it in the soil for me...ah!
Dead man! "
The young man saw a human corpse next to him, thought it was a dummy, and picked it up casually.
Suddenly, the young man was stunned.
The disgusting smell of decay, the fat maggots squirming on the corpse, and the sticky mucus of carrion on the hands, absolutely cannot be fake!
The boy's pupils shrank rapidly, he screamed, kicked his legs wildly, and stepped back.
title_en: Chapter 1 The young man crawling out of the grave Chapter 2 Why can’t I fly?
